unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #2 'A Nano (XNO) rail: the same two-key spend policy, but the second key is a feeless public ledger' on icohangar-ops/two-key. Argued: Nano's single-sign block enforces the spend limit the Vellar policy provides, feeless no-min so micro-spends carry no gas, every both-key decision is a public verifiable block, and an XNO-only agent could settle without a Stellar wallet.
